note: Quantifier node is converted to NODE_STRING via xmemset, zeroing all quantifier fields including the body pointer.
The original body (now a freed node) is concatenated into the converted node; body remains as a dangling pointer.
Body node is freed, but the converted node still references the freed memory through its string buffer pointers.
When the converted node is later processed as NODE_QUANT (if type was not properly updated), NODE_BODY accesses freed memory.
NODE_QUANT_BODY reads qn->body from freed memory, causing heap-use-after-free READ 4.
